title: neosasamorpha oshidensis subsp. glabra
intro: Neosasamorpha oshidensis subsp. glabra, commonly known as Glabrous Oshidense, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Neosasamorpha oshidensis subsp. glabra include its antiseptic, anti-fungal, and anti-bacterial properties, which can be used to treat various conditions such as wounds, infections, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
